68db80441fd732105ceaee7aa28a70d70f9f671c.question: Should meaningful helper extraction and refactoring of real repeated behavior remain allowed when not explicitly requested, or does the ponytail rule prohibiting unrequested abstractions take precedence?
68db80441fd732105ceaee7aa28a70d70f9f671c.answer: Meaningful helper extraction and refactoring remain allowed when they address real repeated behavior or clarify a coherent responsibility, but ponytail prohibits speculative or convenience abstractions. The agent must propose rather than automatically apply an unrequested refactor, and borderline or scope-expanding cases require operator escalation.
